mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_order (id, order_no, merchant_id, amount, channel, channel_trade_no, product_type, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{orderNo}, #{merchantId}, #{amount}, #{channel}, #{channelTradeNo}, #{productType}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = VALUES(status), channel_trade_no = VALUES(channel_trade_no), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
